verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִ֖ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית לֵוִ֑י וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־ בַּת־ לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’îš mib·bêṯ lê·wî way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- baṯ- lê·wî
verses.literal: Now a man of the house of Levi married a Levite woman
verses.literalPt: E FOI um homem da casa de Levi e casou com uma filha de Levi.

verses.original: וַתַּ֥הַר הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתֵּ֤רֶא אֹתוֹ֙ כִּי־ ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַֽתִּצְפְּנֵ֖הוּ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יְרָחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har hā·’iš·šāh wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tê·re ’ō·ṯōw kî- ṭō·wḇ hū wat·tiṣ·pə·nê·hū šə·lō·šāh yə·rā·ḥîm
verses.literal: and she conceived and gave birth to a son When she saw that he was a beautiful child she hid him for three months
verses.literalPt: E a mulher concebeu e deu à luz um filho; e, vendo que ele era formoso, escondeu-o três meses.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָכְלָ֣ה עוֹד֮ הַצְּפִינוֹ֒ וַתִּֽקַּֽח־ לוֹ֙ תֵּ֣בַת גֹּ֔מֶא וַתַּחְמְרָ֥ה בַחֵמָ֖ר וּבַזָּ֑פֶת וַתָּ֤שֶׂם בָּהּ֙ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֔לֶד וַתָּ֥שֶׂם בַּסּ֖וּף עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lāh ‘ō·wḏ haṣ·ṣə·p̄î·nōw wat·tiq·qaḥ- lōw tê·ḇaṯ gō·me wat·taḥ·mə·rāh ḇa·ḥê·mār ū·ḇaz·zā·p̄eṯ wat·tā·śem bāh ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ wat·tā·śem bas·sūp̄ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: But when she could no longer hide him she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch Then she placed the child in the basket and set it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile
verses.literalPt: Não podendo, porém, mais escondê-lo, tomou uma arca de juncos, e a revestiu com barro e betume; e, pondo nela o menino, a pôs nos juncos à margem do rio.

verses.original: וַתֵּתַצַּ֥ב אֲחֹת֖וֹ מֵרָחֹ֑ק לְדֵעָ֕ה מַה־ יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ṯaṣ·ṣaḇ ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw mê·rā·ḥōq lə·ḏê·‘āh mah- yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: And his sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him
verses.literalPt: E sua irmã postou-se de longe, para saber o que lhe havia de acontecer.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤רֶד בַּת־ פַּרְעֹה֙ לִרְחֹ֣ץ עַל־ הַיְאֹ֔ר וְנַעֲרֹתֶ֥יהָ הֹלְכֹ֖ת עַל־ יַ֣ד הַיְאֹ֑ר וַתֵּ֤רֶא אֶת־ הַתֵּבָה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַסּ֔וּף וַתִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֶת־ אֲמָתָ֖הּ וַתִּקָּחֶֽהָ
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·reḏ baṯ- par·‘ōh lir·ḥōṣ ‘al- hay·’ōr wə·na·‘ă·rō·ṯe·hā hō·lə·ḵōṯ ‘al- yaḏ hay·’ōr wat·tê·re ’eṯ- hat·tê·ḇāh bə·ṯō·wḵ has·sūp̄ wat·tiš·laḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·mā·ṯāh wat·tiq·qå̄·ḥɛ·hå̄
verses.literal: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile and her attendants were walking along the riverbank . . . And when she saw the basket among the reeds she sent her maidservant to retrieve it
verses.literalPt: E a filha de Faraó desceu a lavar-se no rio, e as suas donzelas passeavam, pela margem do rio; e ela viu a arca no meio dos juncos, e enviou a sua criada, que a tomou.

verses.original: וַתִּפְתַּח֙ וַתִּרְאֵ֣הוּ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֔לֶד וְהִנֵּה־ נַ֖עַר בֹּכֶ֑ה וַתַּחְמֹ֣ל עָלָ֔יו וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מִיַּלְדֵ֥י הָֽעִבְרִ֖ים זֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tip̄·taḥ wat·tir·’ê·hū ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ wə·hin·nêh- na·‘ar bō·ḵeh wat·taḥ·mōl ‘ā·lāw wat·tō·mer mî·yal·ḏê hā·‘iḇ·rîm zeh
verses.literal: When she opened it she saw the child and behold the little boy was crying So she had compassion on him and said This is one of the Hebrew children
verses.literalPt: E abrindo-a, viu ao menino e eis que o menino chorava; e moveu-se de compaixão dele, e disse: Dos meninos dos hebreus é este.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֲחֹתוֹ֮ אֶל־ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹה֒ הַאֵלֵ֗ךְ וְקָרָ֤אתִי לָךְ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה מֵינֶ֔קֶת מִ֖ן הָעִבְרִיֹּ֑ת וְתֵינִ֥ק לָ֖ךְ אֶת־ הַיָּֽלֶד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw ’el- baṯ- par·‘ōh ha·’ê·lêḵ wə·qā·rā·ṯî lāḵ ’iš·šāh mê·ne·qeṯ min hā·‘iḇ·rî·yōṯ wə·ṯê·niq lāḵ ’eṯ- hay·yā·leḏ
verses.literal: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you
verses.literalPt: Então disse sua irmã à filha de Faraó: Irei chamar uma ama das hebréias, que crie este menino para ti?

verses.original: וַתֹּֽאמֶר־ לָ֥הּ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵ֑כִי וַתֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ הָֽעַלְמָ֔ה וַתִּקְרָ֖א אֶת־ אֵ֥ם הַיָּֽלֶד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer- lāh baṯ- par·‘ōh lê·ḵî wat·tê·leḵ hā·‘al·māh wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- ’êm hay·yā·leḏ
verses.literal: Go ahead Pharaoh’s daughter told her And the girl went and called the boy’s mother
verses.literalPt: E a filha de Faraó disse-lhe: Vai. Foi, pois, a moça, e chamou a mãe do menino.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר לָ֣הּ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֵילִ֜יכִי אֶת־ הַיֶּ֤לֶד הַזֶּה֙ וְהֵינִקִ֣הוּ לִ֔י וַאֲנִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת־ שְׂכָרֵ֑ךְ וַתִּקַּ֧ח הָאִשָּׁ֛ה הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַתְּנִיקֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lāh baṯ- par·‘ōh hê·lî·ḵî ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ haz·zeh wə·hê·ni·qi·hū lî wa·’ă·nî ’et·tên ’eṯ- śə·ḵā·rêḵ wat·tiq·qaḥ hā·’iš·šāh hay·ye·leḏ wat·tə·nî·qê·hū
verses.literal: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her Take this child and nurse him for me and I will pay your wages So the woman took the boy and nursed him
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse a filha de Faraó: Leva este menino, e cria-mo; eu te darei teu salário. E a mulher tomou o menino, e criou-o.

verses.original: וַיִגְדַּ֣ל הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַתְּבִאֵ֙הוּ֙ לְבַת־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ לָ֖הּ לְבֵ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַתֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י מִן־ הַמַּ֖יִם מְשִׁיתִֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·yiḡ·dal hay·ye·leḏ wat·tə·ḇi·’ê·hū lə·ḇaṯ- par·‘ōh way·hî- lāh lə·ḇên wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw mō·šeh wat·tō·mer kî min- ham·ma·yim mə·šî·ṯi·hū
verses.literal: When the child had grown older she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he became her son She named him . . . Moses and explained . . . I drew him out of the water
verses.literalPt: E, quando o menino já era grande, ela o trouxe à filha de Faraó, a qual o adotou; e chamou-lhe Moisés, e disse: Porque das águas o tenho tirado.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם וַיִּגְדַּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֶל־ אֶחָ֔יו וַיַּ֖רְא בְּסִבְלֹתָ֑ם וַיַּרְא֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מַכֶּ֥ה אִישׁ־ עִבְרִ֖י מֵאֶחָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm way·yiḡ·dal mō·šeh way·yê·ṣê ’el- ’e·ḥāw way·yar bə·siḇ·lō·ṯām way·yar ’îš miṣ·rî mak·keh ’îš- ‘iḇ·rî mê·’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: One day . . . after Moses had grown up he went out to his own people and observed their hard labor He saw . . . an Egyptian beating . . . a Hebrew one of his own people
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que, sendo Moisés já homem, saiu a seus irmãos, e atentou para as suas cargas; e viu que um egípcio feria a um hebreu, homem de seus irmãos.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤פֶן כֹּה֙ וָכֹ֔ה וַיַּ֖רְא כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַֽיִּטְמְנֵ֖הוּ בַּחֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en kōh wā·ḵōh way·yar kî ’ên ’îš way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ham·miṣ·rî way·yiṭ·mə·nê·hū ba·ḥō·wl
verses.literal: After looking this way and that and seeing . . . no one he struck down the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand
verses.literalPt: E olhou a um e a outro lado e, vendo que não havia ninguém ali, matou ao egípcio, e escondeu-o na areia.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנֵֽי־ אֲנָשִׁ֥ים עִבְרִ֖ים נִצִּ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָֽרָשָׁ֔ע לָ֥מָּה תַכֶּ֖ה רֵעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê bay·yō·wm haš·šê·nî wə·hin·nêh šə·nê- ’ă·nā·šîm ‘iḇ·rîm niṣ·ṣîm way·yō·mer lā·rā·šā‘ lām·māh ṯak·keh rê·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: The next day Moses went out and saw two . . . Hebrews fighting He asked the one in the wrong Why are you attacking your companion
verses.literalPt: E tornou a sair no dia seguinte, e eis que dois homens hebreus contendiam; e disse ao injusto: Por que feres a teu próximo?

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר מִ֣י שָֽׂמְךָ֞ לְאִ֨ישׁ שַׂ֤ר וְשֹׁפֵט֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ הַלְהָרְגֵ֙נִי֙ אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרַ֖גְתָּ אֶת־ הַמִּצְרִ֑י וַיִּירָ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אָכֵ֖ן נוֹדַ֥ע הַדָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mî śā·mə·ḵā lə·’îš śar wə·šō·p̄êṭ ‘ā·lê·nū hal·hā·rə·ḡê·nî ’at·tāh ’ō·mêr ka·’ă·šer hā·raḡ·tā ’eṯ- ham·miṣ·rî way·yî·rā mō·šeh way·yō·mar ’ā·ḵên nō·w·ḏa‘ had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: But the man replied Who made you ruler and judge over us Are you planning to kill me as you killed the Egyptian Then Moses was afraid and thought This thing I have done has surely become known
verses.literalPt: O qual disse: Quem te tem posto a ti por maioral e juiz sobre nós? Pensas matar-me, como mataste o egípcio? Então temeu Moisés, e disse: Certamente este negócio foi descoberto.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לַהֲרֹ֣ג אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּבְרַ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִדְיָ֖ן וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב עַֽל־ הַבְּאֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ par·‘ōh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh way·ḇaq·qêš la·hă·rōḡ ’eṯ- mō·šeh way·yiḇ·raḥ mō·šeh mip·pə·nê p̄ar·‘ōh way·yê·šeḇ bə·’e·reṣ- miḏ·yān way·yê·šeḇ ‘al- hab·bə·’êr
verses.literal: When Pharaoh - heard about this matter he sought to kill Moses But Moses fled from Pharaoh and settled in the land of Midian where he sat down beside a well
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, Faraó este caso, procurou matar a Moisés; mas Moisés fugiu de diante da face de Faraó, e habitou na terra de Midiã, e assentou-se junto a um poço.

verses.original: וּלְכֹהֵ֥ן מִדְיָ֖ן שֶׁ֣בַע בָּנ֑וֹת וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה וַתִּדְלֶ֗נָה וַתְּמַלֶּ֙אנָה֙ אֶת־ הָ֣רְהָטִ֔ים לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת צֹ֥אן אֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḵō·hên miḏ·yān še·ḇa‘ bā·nō·wṯ wat·tā·ḇō·nāh wat·tiḏ·le·nāh wat·tə·mal·le·nāh ’eṯ- hā·rə·hā·ṭîm lə·haš·qō·wṯ ṣōn ’ă·ḇî·hen
verses.literal: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote de Midiã tinha sete filhas, as quais vieram tirar água, e encheram os bebedouros, para dar de beber ao rebanho de seu pai.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָרֹעִ֖ים וַיְגָרְשׁ֑וּם וַיָּ֤קָם מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיּ֣וֹשִׁעָ֔ן וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־ צֹאנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū hā·rō·‘îm way·ḡā·rə·šūm way·yā·qām mō·šeh way·yō·wō·ši·‘ān way·yašq ’eṯ- ṣō·nām
verses.literal: And when some shepherds came along and drove them away Moses rose up to help them and watered their flock
verses.literalPt: Então vieram os pastores, e expulsaram-nas dali; Moisés, porém, levantou-se e defendeu-as, e deu de beber ao rebanho.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֕אנָה אֶל־ רְעוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִיהֶ֑ן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֛וּעַ מִהַרְתֶּ֥ן בֹּ֖א הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·nāh ’el- rə·‘ū·’êl ’ă·ḇî·hen way·yō·mer mad·dū·a‘ mi·har·ten bō hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: When the daughters returned to their father Reuel he asked them Why have you returned so early today
verses.literalPt: E voltando elas a Reuel seu pai, ele disse: Por que hoje tornastes tão depressa?

verses.original: וַתֹּאמַ֕רְןָ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י הִצִּילָ֖נוּ מִיַּ֣ד הָרֹעִ֑ים וְגַם־ דָּלֹ֤ה דָלָה֙ לָ֔נוּ וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mar·nā ’îš miṣ·rî hiṣ·ṣî·lā·nū mî·yaḏ hā·rō·‘îm wə·ḡam- dā·lōh ḏā·lāh lā·nū way·yašq ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds they replied . . . He even drew water . . . for us and watered the flock
verses.literalPt: E elas disseram: Um homem egípcio nos livrou da mão dos pastores; e também nos tirou água em abundância, e deu de beber ao rebanho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ בְּנֹתָ֖יו וְאַיּ֑וֹ לָ֤מָּה זֶּה֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ן אֶת־ הָאִ֔ישׁ קִרְאֶ֥ן ל֖וֹ וְיֹ֥אכַל לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- bə·nō·ṯāw wə·’ay·yōw lām·māh zeh ‘ă·zaḇ·ten ’eṯ- hā·’îš qir·’en lōw wə·yō·ḵal lā·ḥem
verses.literal: So where is he their father asked . . . . . . Why . . . did you leave the man behind Invite him to have something to eat . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse a suas filhas: E onde está ele? Por que deixastes o homem? Chamai-o para que coma pão.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹאֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיִּתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ צִפֹּרָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְמֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·’el mō·šeh lā·še·ḇeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’îš way·yit·tên ’eṯ- ṣip·pō·rāh ḇit·tōw lə·mō·šeh
verses.literal: Moses agreed to stay with the man and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage
verses.literalPt: E Moisés consentiu em morar com aquele homem; e ele deu a Moisés sua filha Zípora,

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ גֵּרְשֹׁ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּאֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ bên way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw gê·rə·šōm kî ’ā·mar gêr hā·yî·ṯî bə·’e·reṣ nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: And she gave birth to a son and Moses named him . . . . . . Gershom saying I have become a foreigner in a foreign land
verses.literalPt: A qual deu à luz um filho, a quem ele chamou Gérson, porque disse: Peregrino fui em terra estranha.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיָּמִ֨ים הָֽרַבִּ֜ים הָהֵ֗ם וַיָּ֙מָת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֵּאָנְח֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִן־ הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה וַיִּזְעָ֑קוּ וַתַּ֧עַל שַׁוְעָתָ֛ם אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־ הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇay·yā·mîm hā·rab·bîm hā·hêm way·yā·māṯ me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim way·yê·’ā·nə·ḥū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh way·yiz·‘ā·qū wat·ta·‘al šaw·‘ā·ṯām ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm min- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: After a long . . . time the king of Egypt died The Israelites . . . groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu, depois de muitos dias, que morrendo o rei do Egito, os filhos de Israel suspiraram por causa da servidão, e clamaram; e o seu clamor subiu a Deus por causa de sua servidão.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ נַאֲקָתָ֑ם וַיִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ בְּרִית֔וֹ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ יִצְחָ֥ק וְאֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- na·’ă·qā·ṯām way·yiz·kōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯōw ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq wə·’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: So God heard their groaning and He remembered His covenant with Abraham . . . Isaac . . . and Jacob
verses.literalPt: E ouviu Deus o seu gemido, e lembrou-se Deus da sua aliança com Abraão, com Isaque, e com Jacó;

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֖דַע אֱלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·ḏa‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God saw the Israelites . . . and took notice
verses.literalPt: E viu Deus os filhos de Israel, e atentou Deus para a sua condição.
